question: Which Large Corporate clients with more than $25 million of active commitments have had no contact from any banker in the last 90 days?
answer:
**12 of the 38 Large Corporate clients with more than $25M of active commitments have had no contact from any banker in the last 90 days.** Together they hold **$352.2M** of active commitments. None of them is close to the cutoff: the most recent contact for any of them was 136 days ago, and the longest gap is 242 days.

| # | CIF | Client | Active commitments | Facilities | Last contact (any banker) | Days since | Coverage RM (team) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0000041178 | Dunmore Technologies LLC | $38.1M | 2 | 2026-02-17 (RM) | 225 | Sawyer Rourke (C&I East) |
| 2 | 0000041205 | Eastvale Industries Co | $35.2M | 3 | 2026-04-26 (RM) | 157 | Gray Lowry (C&I East) |
| 3 | 0000041251 | Glenhaven Systems Inc | $30.5M | 2 | 2026-05-17 (TM officer) | 136 | Gray Lowry (C&I East) |
| 4 | 0000041099 | Stellmark-Orsa Ventures JV LLC | $30.0M | 1 | 2026-04-15 (RM) | 168 | Dana Abbott (C&I Central) |
| 5 | 0000041313 | Ivorline Energy LLC | $29.6M | 2 | 2026-03-08 (RM) | 206 | Jordan Thorne (C&I East) |
| 6 | 0000041128 | Alderwick Group Inc | $28.4M | 2 | 2026-05-10 (RM) | 143 | Jordan Thorne (C&I East) |
| 7 | 0000041243 | Glenhaven Properties Inc | $28.2M | 2 | 2026-03-28 (RM) | 186 | Sage Garrow (C&I East) |
| 8 | 0000041139 | Alderwick Health Inc | $27.9M | 2 | 2026-01-31 (RM) | 242 | Harper Garrow (C&I East) |
| 9 | 0000041445 | Oakhurst Systems Inc | $26.5M | 3 | 2026-03-06 (RM) | 208 | Marlow Nolan (C&I West) |
| 10 | 0000041615 | Valewood Technologies Inc | $26.2M | 2 | 2026-03-24 (RM) | 190 | Dana Abbott (C&I Central) |
| 11 | 0000041053 | Brightwater Supply Co | $25.8M | 2 | 2026-03-23 (TM officer) | 191 | Sage Garrow (C&I East) |
| 12 | 0000041037 | Brightwater Manufacturing LLC | $25.8M | 2 | 2026-03-14 (RM) | 200 | Sawyer Rourke (C&I East) |

**Where they sit:** 9 are in C&I East, 2 in C&I Central and 1 in C&I West. Five RMs (Rourke, Lowry, Thorne, Garrow and Abbott) each have two of these clients.

**Sources and definitions**
- **Large Corporate:** clients with segment code `LC` in `BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT`, matched to "Large Corporate" in `REF.SEGMENT`.
- **Active commitments:** the total commitment amount of facilities with status `ACTIVE` in `LENDING.FACILITY`, summed per client. Paid-off and charged-off facilities are left out. The threshold is strictly more than $25M, so two Large Corporate clients at exactly $25.0M are excluded. Both were contacted recently anyway (2026-08-17 and 2026-09-28).
- **Contact from any banker:** any contact logged in `CORE.RM_CONTACT`, from either an RM or a treasury management officer, through any channel (call, email, meeting or site visit).
- **No contact in the last 90 days:** the client's latest contact was before 2026-07-02, which is 90 days before the 2026-09-30 data date.
- **Coverage RM:** the client's assigned RM in `CORE.CLIENT`, with names and teams from `CORE.RM_ROSTER`.

**Assumptions and caveats**
- **Past maturity dates:** 1,071 facilities marked active have a maturity date before 2026-09-30. All of them still have a September 2026 balance record, so they are on the books. The maturity dates are probably out of date (for example, renewals that weren't updated), and I counted these facilities as active. Counting only unexpired facilities would leave just 17 clients over the $25M threshold, so you may want to clean up these maturity dates.
- **Logged contacts only:** this uses only contacts recorded in the CRM. Contact that was never logged wouldn't show up.
- **Other data:** I didn't need the Fabric risk data, and I didn't use the restricted financial-crime (SAR) table.

sql.sql:
select 'seg' k, segment_cd v, count(*) n from BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT group by 2
union all select 'status', client_status, count(*) from BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT group by 2
union all select 'fstatus', facility_status, count(*) from BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY group by 2
union all select 'role', banker_role, count(*) from BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_CONTACT group by 2
union all select 'channel', channel, count(*) from BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_CONTACT group by 2
union all select 'ciflen', length(cif_no)::text, count(*) from BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT group by 2
union all select 'ciflen_contact', length(cif_no)::text, count(*) from BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_CONTACT group by 2
union all select 'ciflen_fac', length(cif_no)::text, count(*) from BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY group by 2
order by 1,2

select
 (select count(*)-count(distinct cif_no) from BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT) dup_cif,
 (select count(*) from BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY where facility_status='ACTIVE' and (payoff_dt is not null or chgoff_dt is not null)) active_w_close,
 (select count(*) from BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY where facility_status='ACTIVE' and maturity_dt < '2026-09-30') active_matured,
 (select count(*) from BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY where commit_amt is null or commit_amt<=0) bad_commit,
 (select max(contact_dt) from BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_CONTACT) max_ct,
 (select min(contact_dt) from BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_CONTACT) min_ct,
 (select count(*) from BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_CONTACT where contact_dt > '2026-09-30') future_ct,
 (select count(*) from BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_CONTACT where contact_dt is null) null_ct,
 (select count(*)-count(distinct facility_id) from BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY) dup_fac,
 (select count(*) from BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_CONTACT c where not exists (select 1 from BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT k where k.cif_no=c.cif_no)) orphan_ct

with fac as (
  select cif_no, sum(commit_amt) active_commit, count(*) n_fac
  from BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY where facility_status='ACTIVE' group by cif_no),
ct as (
  select cif_no, max(contact_dt) last_any,
   max(iff(banker_role='RM',contact_dt,null)) last_rm,
   max(iff(banker_role='TM_OFFICER',contact_dt,null)) last_tm,
   count_if(contact_dt between '2026-06-25' and '2026-07-09') near_boundary
  from BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_CONTACT group by cif_no)
select c.cif_no, c.client_nm, c.rm_id, r.rm_nm, r.team, f.active_commit, f.n_fac,
  ct.last_any, ct.last_rm, ct.last_tm, datediff(day, ct.last_any, '2026-09-30'::date) days_since
from BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT c
join fac f on f.cif_no=c.cif_no
left join ct on ct.cif_no=c.cif_no
left join BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_ROSTER r on r.rm_id=c.rm_id
where c.segment_cd='LC' and f.active_commit>25000000
  and (ct.last_any is null or ct.last_any < dateadd(day,-90,'2026-09-30'::date))
order by f.active_commit desc

with fac as (
  select f.cif_no, sum(f.commit_amt) active_commit,
    sum(iff(f.maturity_dt >= '2026-09-30', f.commit_amt, 0)) unmatured_commit,
    sum(iff(b.facility_id is not null, f.commit_amt, 0)) commit_with_sep_bal
  from BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY f
  left join (select distinct facility_id from BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY_BAL_MTHLY where as_of_dt='2026-09-30') b on b.facility_id=f.facility_id
  where f.facility_status='ACTIVE' group by f.cif_no)
select count(*) lc_gt25, count_if(active_commit=25000000) exactly25,
  count_if(unmatured_commit>25000000) gt25_unmatured, count_if(commit_with_sep_bal>25000000) gt25_with_sep_bal
from fac join BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT c on c.cif_no=fac.cif_no
where c.segment_cd='LC' and active_commit>=25000000

with fac as (
  select f.cif_no, sum(f.commit_amt) active_commit,
    sum(iff(f.maturity_dt >= '2026-09-30', f.commit_amt, 0)) unmatured_commit,
    sum(iff(b.facility_id is not null, f.commit_amt, 0)) commit_with_sep_bal
  from BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY f
  left join (select distinct facility_id from BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY_BAL_MTHLY where snap_dt='2026-09-30') b on b.facility_id=f.facility_id
  where f.facility_status='ACTIVE' group by f.cif_no)
select count_if(active_commit>25000000) lc_gt25, count_if(active_commit=25000000) exactly25,
  count_if(unmatured_commit>25000000) gt25_unmatured, count_if(commit_with_sep_bal>25000000) gt25_with_sep_bal
from fac join BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT c on c.cif_no=fac.cif_no
where c.segment_cd='LC'

with fac as (select cif_no, sum(commit_amt) c from BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY where facility_status='ACTIVE' group by cif_no)
select k.cif_no, k.client_nm, fac.c, max(ct.contact_dt) last_ct
from BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT k join fac on fac.cif_no=k.cif_no
left join BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_CONTACT ct on ct.cif_no=k.cif_no
where k.segment_cd='LC' and fac.c=25000000 group by 1,2,3
